name: Sarmazenil
summary: Sarmazenil (Ro15-3505) is a drug from the benzodiazepine family. It acts as a partial inverse agonist of benzodiazepine receptors, meaning that it causes the opposite effects to most benzodiazepine drugs, and instead acts as an anxiogenic and convulsant. It is used in veterinary medicine to reverse the effects of benzodiazepine sedative drugs in order to rapidly re-awaken anesthetized animals.

pharmacology.text: It acts as a partial inverse agonist of benzodiazepine receptors, meaning that it causes the opposite effects to most benzodiazepine drugs, and instead acts as an anxiogenic and convulsant.

uses.text: It is used in veterinary medicine to reverse the effects of benzodiazepine sedative drugs in order to rapidly re-awaken anesthetized animals.

sideEffects.en: Because it does the opposite of a benzodiazepine, it can cause anxiety, agitation and seizures, and it can bring on withdrawal seizures in animals or people dependent on benzodiazepines.
sideEffects.zh: 由於它的作用和苯二氮平相反，可能引起焦慮、躁動和癲癇發作，也可能使依賴苯二氮平的動物或人出現戒斷性癲癇。
sideEffects.zhHans: 由于它的作用和苯二氮平相反，可能引起焦虑、躁动和癫痫发作，也可能使依赖苯二氮平的动物或人出现戒断性癫痫。

fact.en: Sarmazenil is used in veterinary medicine to wake animals from benzodiazepine sedation. Unlike flumazenil, which simply blocks the site, it actively does the opposite of a benzodiazepine there.
fact.zh: 沙馬西尼用於獸醫，使動物從苯二氮平鎮靜中甦醒。和單純阻斷該位點的氟馬西尼不同，它在那個位點上主動發揮和苯二氮平相反的作用。
fact.zhHans: 沙马西尼用于兽医，使动物从苯二氮平镇静中苏醒。和单纯阻断该位点的氟马西尼不同，它在那个位点上主动发挥和苯二氮平相反的作用。
